key.name: usage-tracking
key.description: Count data transferred over Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and mobile connections, with daily system statistics. Saved data is encrypted with a key kept in the login keyring. Turning this off stops counting and keeps saved statistics.

key.name: usage-track-networks
key.description: Also record usage per connection name (for example the Wi-Fi network name). Network names can reveal places you have been; they are stored encrypted, and turning this off forgets the recorded names.

key.name: usage-billing-day
key.description: Day of the month on which the monthly usage period starts.

key.name: usage-week-start
key.description: 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday, and 6 is Saturday.

key.name: usage-monthly-cap-gib
key.description: Warn when the billing cycle's download plus upload approaches or reaches this limit. 0 turns warnings off.

key.name: usage-cap-warning-percent
key.description: Percentage of the monthly limit at which the first warning is shown.

key.name: usage-retention-days
key.summary: Days of daily history to keep
key.description: Older daily records are removed. Monthly and all-time totals are kept.

key.name: usage-reset-request
key.description: Internal: preferences set this to ask the extension to delete all usage statistics.
